pages.text: An electric furnace. Smelts in $(bold)half the time$(), with no fuel or air.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: Link it with the Binder. One input, one output.$(br2)It draws $(bold)2 kW$() while working and nothing while idle. Losing power pauses the job.

pages.title: Uranium
pages.text: Only this furnace refines Raw Uranium into Uranium Concentrate: $(bold)8 kW$() for 30 s each, at 1,200°C.$(br2)See $(l:reactor/fuel)Fuel Rods$(/l).

pages.title: Specs
pages.text: $(li)Waste heat: 0.5 kW into the room$(li)Changing the input resets progress$(li)Status: Idle, Waiting for power, Smelting, No recipe, Output blocked
Two furnaces, iron, copper and redstone.
